halomcc-your-journey-begins-467ebc6bb3.description: Tamal ab misioŋu kampaañ wala ab match multijoueur.
halomcc-your-journey-begins-467ebc6bb3.guideDescription: Ngir mëna tijji "Your Journey Begins" ci Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), li ngay def du lenn ludul matt bépp misioŋu kampaañ wala match multijoueur.

halomcc-just-getting-started-24ea4c9ab6.guideDescription: Ngir mëna tijji "Just Getting Started" ci Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), li ngay def du lenn ludul ray 100 noon wala joueur ci bépp misioŋu kampaañ wala match multijoueur.

halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.description: Halo: Reach: Wut siife binar bu nëbbu bi.
halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.guideDescription:
Ngir tijji "I’m Sorry, Dave" def ci Halo: Reach ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), danga wara wut nen bu gëna neex buy sargal David Candland, njiitu UI jeu bi. Lii dafay leeral ni ñu koy gisee:

1. Tàmbalil bépp misioŋu kampaañ wala kàrtu joueur yu bari ci Halo: Reach.
2. Tannal benn arme bu **amul** man-manu zoom scope. Ay misaal yuñ gëna xam ñooy Fusil bi wala Pistole Plasma.
3. Bësal zoom bi (dafay faral di nekk stick bu ndeyjoor ci console yi wala butoŋ biñ tànn ci PC bi) ngir "zoom in" ak sa arme bu amul scope.
4. Xoolal bu baax **koñu cammoy bi ci suuf** ci sa ekraŋ. Di nga gis benn chaîne de kod binär buy feeñ ci diir bu gàtt.
5. Kod binar bii dafay tekki baat "Dave" ci misaal binar ASCII.

Soo toppee jéego yii nga seetlu kodu binar bi, di nga ubbi "I’m Sorry, Dave" def.

halomcc-balaho-s-most-wanted-03c5a591ce.guideDescription: Ngir tijji "Balaho’s Most Wanted" def ci Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), fàww nga dindi 100 Grunts ci anam PVE, lu ci melni Kampaañ, Firefight, ak Spartan Ops. Amna chance, lii mën nañu ko dindi ci anam wu yomb sooy jouer normal.

halomcc-where-am-i-0ea732d545.guideDescription: Ngir mëna tijji "Where Am I?" ci Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), li ngay def du lenn ludul def 10 misioŋu kampaañ wala 10 match yu bari.

halomcc-the-one-percent-088630ade1.guideDescription: Ngir dindi "The One Percent" def ci Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), fàww nga dindi 100 Elites ci anam PVE, lu ci melni Kampaañ, Firefight, ak Spartan Ops. Amna chance, lii mën nañu ko dindi ci anam wu yomb sooy jouer normal.

halomcc-we-re-just-getting-started-4fd09.description: Halo: Reach: Sedd bu mat sëkk.
halomcc-we-re-just-getting-started-4fd09.guideDescription: Ngir mëna ubbi "We're Just Getting Started" ci Halo: Reach ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), li ngay def du lenn ludul jouer ci "Winter Contingency" mission ci ndoorte ba ci njeexte ci bépp jafe-jafe.

halomcc-spoilsport-3dada00509.guideDescription: Ngir tijji "Spoilsport" def ci Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), fàww nga dindi 100 Jackals ci mode PVE, boole ci Kampaañ, Firefight, ak Spartan Ops. Amna chance, lii mën nañu ko dindi ci anam wu yomb sooy jouer normal.

halomcc-just-a-taste-9a52606cd4.guideDescription: Ngir mëna dindi "Just A Taste" ci Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), fàww nga dajale 500 medaayu kampaañ wala playlist. Mën nga am meday yooyu sooy jouer ci kampaañ bi wala sooy bokk ci matchmaking. Ngir yokk sa yokkute, defal sa xel ci ray noon yi ci anam wu gaaw te baax, nga fexe am medaayu ray yu bari ak ray yu bari. Fo ci jafe-jafe bu yomb ci kampaañ bi mooy liñu lay digal, ndax daf lay may nga dajale meday te doo yokk jafe-jafe yu gëna rëy.

halomcc-protocol-dictates-action-e8ac811.description: Halo: Reach: ONI bu mat: Base epe.
halomcc-protocol-dictates-action-e8ac811.guideDescription: Ngir mëna ubbi "Protocol Dictates Action" ci Halo: Reach ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), li ngay def du lenn ludul jouer ci "Protocol Dictates Action" mission ci ndoorte ba ci njeexte ci bépp jafe-jafe.

halomcc-stick-with-it-a-little-longer-17.description: Foowu nga jeu multijoueur wala co-op 3 weer ginaaw bi nga defee jeu bu njëkk bi.
halomcc-stick-with-it-a-little-longer-17.guideDescription:
Ngir mëna dindi "Stick With It...A Little Longer" ci Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), li ngay def du lenn ludul jouer jeu multijoueur wala jeu co-op 3 weer ginaaw boo jouer sa jeu bu njëkk.

Bii wuute na ak yeneen mbir, lii mënu ñu ko tëj ci jaay sa bisu sistem, ndax serwër bi moo ko firnde.

halomcc-pillar-of-autumn-ca48de1ce8.description: Halo CE: Matal Ponku Otomn bi.
halomcc-pillar-of-autumn-ca48de1ce8.guideDescription: Ngir ubbi "Pillar of Autumn" def ci Halo: CE ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), li ngay def du lenn ludul jouer ci "Pillar of Autumn" mission ci ndoorte ba ci njeexte ci bépp jafe-jafe.

halomcc-the-guardians-are-coming-f21d333.description: Gardien yi dina ñu la ray.
halomcc-the-guardians-are-coming-f21d333.guideDescription:
"The Guardians Are Coming" biñu def ci Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC) mën nañu ko tëj suñu daje ak ëlëg gu amul fenn: ñu ray leen ci anam wuy jaaxal motëru jeu bi. Su loolu amee, jeu bi dafay faral di wane mesaas bii, "You were killed by The Guardians." Lii mooy anam wu yomb ngir am ndam lii:

1. Ci mënu bi gëna mag ci Halo MCC, tannal kampaañu Halo 2.
2. Demal ci tànneef misioŋ.
3. Defar kaaŋu scarab bi mu nekk luy dox.
4. Sargal mission bi njëkk wala beneen mission boo taamu.
5. Fo ba nga am ngannaay.
6. Tiire ci dër bi.
7. Realisation ubbeeku!

Soo toppee tegtal yii, di nga am "The Guardians Are Coming" ci sa koleksion.

halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.description: Halo CE: Xeex ci wetu Chips Dubbo te déglu kàddoom yu am xel.
halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.guideDescription:
Ngir am "My Buddy Chips" ci Halo: Combat Evolved ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection, fàww nga daje ak nit ki Chips Dubbo ci diiru kampaañu Halo: Combat Evolved. Mën nañu ko fekk ci misioŋu bari, waaye joueur yu bari amnañu ndam ci misioŋu "The Pillar of Autumn."

Fexeel dundu sa marine, rawatina ci wàll wi forsu Covenant yi di duggu ci sa gaal, te déglu waxtaan bu wuute bu Dubbo. Achievement bi dafa wara ubbeeku ginaaw ndaje bii.

Dafay am solo lool ñu xam ni feeñug Chips Dubbo mën na nekk lu bari, te sudee danga am jafe-jafe gis ko, jéemal def misioŋ bi te nga jël ko ndànk, nga fexe ba des ak say marine te déglu seen waxtaan1.

halomcc-i-need-a-weapon-0305f283a3.description: Halo: Reach: Guddi gu mat sëkk.
halomcc-i-need-a-weapon-0305f283a3.guideDescription: Ngir mëna ubbi "I Need A Weapon" ci Halo: Reach ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), li ngay def du lenn ludul jouer ci "Nightfall" mission ci ndoorte ba ci njeexte ci bépp jafe-jafe.

halomcc-bite-the-hand-cc4675d512.description: Ray ab developpeur ci matchmaking wala nit ku am lii
halomcc-bite-the-hand-cc4675d512.guideDescription: Ngir tijji "Bite The Hand" ci Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), taxawal rang ngir matchmaking joueur yu bari te ray say noon ci match normal yi. Target bi mën na nekk developpeur wala joueur bu jota def lii, kon wéyal di jouer ba nga am kill bu lay may nga mëna ko def. Wideo bi dafay wane Halo 4 bi njëkk ci liggéey bi, biy jëfandikoo benn dekkileer matchmaking.

halomcc-mind-the-skill-gap-566b495f16.description: Halo: Reach: Xoolal logo benn kompiñi mine buñ butoŋu.
halomcc-mind-the-skill-gap-566b495f16.guideDescription: Soo bëggee tijji "Mind the Skill Gap" ci Halo: Reach ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ci catu lansa bi, seetal logo BXR Mining ci barabu mine bi. Taxawal ci barab bi nga mëna gisee bu baax nga xool ndànk ci siñaalu liggéeyukaay bi ngir tàmbali def li nga def.

halomcc-all-out-of-bubblegum-22bdb2c4d2.guideDescription: Ngir mëna dindi "All Out of Bubblegum" ci Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), fàww nga dajale 1000 medaayu kampaañ wala playlist. Mën nga am meday yooyu sooy jouer ci kampaañ bi wala sooy bokk ci matchmaking. Ngir yokk sa yokkute, defal sa xel ci ray noon yi ci anam wu gaaw te baax, nga fexe am medaayu ray yu bari ak ray yu bari. Fo ci jafe-jafe bu yomb ci kampaañ bi mooy liñu lay digal, ndax daf lay may nga dajale meday te doo yokk jafe-jafe yu gëna rëy.

halomcc-halo-6ecaacfb1e.guideDescription: Ngir mëna ubbi "Halo" ci Halo: Combat Evolved ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), li ngay def du lenn ludul jouer ci "Halo" mission ci ndoorte ba ci njeexte ci bépp jafe-jafe.

halomcc-standard-operating-brocedure-ffb.description: Tamal bépp niveau co-op ci jafe-jafe normal.
halomcc-standard-operating-brocedure-ffb.guideDescription:
Ngir mëna tijji "Standard Operating Brocedure" ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), li ngay def du lenn ludul matt bépp niveau co-op ci jafe-jafe Normal.

Mën nga itam am "Standard Operating Brocedure" soo jouer ci jafe-jafe Heroic wala Legendary.

halomcc-you-flew-pretty-good-ef665babe8.description: Halo: Reach: Guddi gu gudd gu mat sëkk.
halomcc-you-flew-pretty-good-ef665babe8.guideDescription: Ngir mëna ubbi "You Flew Pretty Good" ci Halo: Reach ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), li ngay def du lenn ludul jouer ci "Long Night of Solace" mission ci ndoorte ba ci njeexte ci bépp jafe-jafe.

halomcc-truth-and-reconciliation-3d669bd.description: Halo CE: Matal Dëgg ak Jubluwaay.
halomcc-truth-and-reconciliation-3d669bd.guideDescription: Ngir mëna ubbi "Truth and Reconciliation" ci Halo: Combat Evolved ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), li ngay def du lenn ludul jouer ci "Truth and Reconciliation" mission ci ndoorte ba ci njeexte ci bépp jafe-jafe.

halomcc-into-the-howling-dark-faf89601ca.guideDescription: Ngir mëna ubbi "Into The Howling Dark" ci Halo: Reach ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), li ngay def du lenn ludul jouer ci "Exodus" mission ci ndoorte ba ci njeexte ci bépp jafe-jafe.

halomcc-front-page-news-951f11d7eb.description: Halo: Reach: Wutal ma ci club bi.
halomcc-front-page-news-951f11d7eb.guideDescription: Ngir tijji "Front Page News" ci Halo: Reach ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), wut ma ci club bi. Jëfandikool wideo bi ngir ràññee barab bi nga wara jaar. Sudee ab mbir la, jegeel ko bu baax balaa ngay wéy di jaar ci barab bi.

halomcc-dust-and-echoes-abf0cf7266.description: Halo: Reach: Alexandrie bu bees bi mat.
halomcc-dust-and-echoes-abf0cf7266.guideDescription: Ngir tijji "Dust And Echoes" ci Halo: Reach ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), yab New Alexandrie ci ndoorte li ci bépp jafe-jafe te jouer ba ci mébet bu mujj bi. Toppal màrku misioŋ yi nga jeexal niveau bi suko defee ñu bind li leer ci Mission Select.

halomcc-the-silent-cartographer-463f102f.description: Halo CE: Tamal Kartograaf bu noppi bi.
halomcc-the-silent-cartographer-463f102f.guideDescription: Soo bëggee tijji "The Silent Cartographer" ci Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), yab Cartographer bu noppi bi ci ndoorte li ci bépp jafe-jafe te jouer ba ci mébet bu mujj bi. Danga njëkka yegg ci gaaraasu kaaraange gi ngir ubbi barab bi, ba noppi nga wàcci dem ci Cartographer bi.

halomcc-what-about-bob-d728d4e4c1.description: Halo: Reach: Wut te dindi benn ci Elite Komanda Ranger yi nëbbu.
halomcc-what-about-bob-d728d4e4c1.guideDescription: Ngir tijji "What About Bob?" ci Halo: Reach ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), wutal te dindi benn ci Elite Komanda Ranger yi nëbbu. Jëfandikool wideo bi ngir ràññee barab bi nga wara jaar. Sudee ab mbir la, jegeel ko bu baax balaa ngay wéy di jaar ci barab bi.

halomcc-easy-to-overlook-7e6f804af3.description: Halo: Reach: Dugg ci waxtaanu radio UNSC bu nëbbu.
halomcc-easy-to-overlook-7e6f804af3.guideDescription: Ngir tijji "Easy to Overlook" ci Halo: Reach ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dugg ci waxtaan radio UNSC bu nëbbu. Tàmbaleel ci barab biñ wane ci wideo bi nga topp tabb gi balaa ngay jéema def jëf ji.

halomcc-your-heresy-will-stay-your-feet-.description: Halo: Reach: Ray Zealot Elite balaa muy mëna daw ci jamonoy Tip of the Spear.
halomcc-your-heresy-will-stay-your-feet-.guideDescription: Ngir tijji "Your Heresy Will Stay Your Feet" ci Halo: Reach ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ray Zealot bu mag bi balaa muy mëna daw ci Tip of the Spear. Jëfandikool benn arme, oto wala position bi ñu wane ci wideo bi. Sudee mébet bi dafay laaj dóor bu mujj, nga bàyyi def yeneen loraange ginaaw bi mébet bi néewee doole.

halomcc-the-chips-dubbo-46489745e0.description: Halo 2: Xeex ak Chips Dubbo bu mag bi nga déglu kàddoom yi.
halomcc-the-chips-dubbo-46489745e0.guideDescription: Ngir tijji "THE Chips Dubbo?" ci Halo 2: Anniversary ci biir Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), jouer Outskirts te des ci wetu Marines yi nga xeex ci ndaje yu njëkk yi. Fexeel dundal Marine biy lakk Australien te jege ko ba nga dégg Chips Dubbo wax. Sudee daa dee balaa nga koy dégg, tàmbaliwaat ci barabu ubbite bi.
